title: Polish the home page on mobile
request: the home page specifically for mobile

criteria.text: At 360px the Sign in button no longer covers the 717REC wordmark; Sign in keeps an accessible name
Open mobile menu: brand logo stays at the top of the panel and the panel is laid out normally (checked at 390 and 360; navbar checked on /, /stats and a team page)
Pending Scores team names are readable: wider name boxes (were 28px and 112px at 390) and up to 2 lines
There is at least 16px between the hero 2x2 grid and the first hero card (was 0px)
Team of the Week name and Top Teams card names show up to 2 lines (were cut at 149px and 106px)
Light theme: Team of the Week label, +8.2%, '13% shot', 'W4' and the negative mover meet 4.5:1
Hero cards no longer add dead Tab stops (tabIndex -1 on the motion wrappers); real links and buttons stay focusable
'View All' keeps at least 12px gap below the description when it wraps
No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390, touched components' tests pass

notes.text: Left alone / needs Doug: Champions amber card white text ~2:1 and Event card contrast (look change); Join the League button style 1.05:1; Report drawer focus trap (vaul autoFocus, 6 files); global scroll-padding-bottom for the bottom nav (all pages, recommend yes); hero grid colours; announcement preset text (database data); Top Teams swipe peek 8px at 360; No Logo Available text; Pending title font; loading layout shift; heading levels. External hosts contacted by the page: progressier.app/.com and cdn.gpteng.co (not league data). Human choice: fake-data screenshots.
